title: Physically Qualified Imagination II: Stable-Base Composition
research_question: Can invariant-base composition turn generated unilateral and bilateral hand-raising intent into solver-accepted G1 behavior without retraining or weakening the physical safety gate?
robustness_condition: Seeded 0.95 to 1.05 multiplicative stiffness and damping calibration at difficulty band 1.
primary_endpoint: Qualified success requires every requested wrist COM to reach at least 0.88 m above the static support surface and realize at least 0.20 m of upward excursion from its first accepted step, zero terminations, zero failed environment steps, minimum root height above 0.64 m, and maximum tilt below 0.50 rad.
amendment: Version 3 was frozen after solver-resident wrist diagnostics falsified the version-2 shoulder proxy: the former left and bilateral compositions changed shoulder pitch without raising the left wrist. Version 3 mirrors one generated right-arm skill across the G1 sagittal plane, shortens only the bilateral horizon to 32 steps after a previously used diagnostic seed showed 16 post-command steps below the unchanged tilt boundary, and moves to five untouched robustness seeds. Versions 1 and 2 are not used for the strengthened paper claim.
composition: Root, legs, waist, and unrequested arm remain at the fixed stable reference. One generated right-arm trajectory is used directly on the right and mirrored across the G1 sagittal plane on the left. Requested arms are uniformly scaled only to satisfy compiled position and velocity limits; the bilateral target is reduced to -0.55 rad while unilateral targets remain -0.65 rad.
claim_gates: all 30 task-method-seed cells complete from a clean numisolver revision
raw state traces, solver-resident wrist traces, and exact commands retained
simulator evidence is not hardware evidence
